title.en: Energy sources and maximum power transfer
title.kn: ಶಕ್ತಿ ಆಕರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ

heading.en: Why does a car's headlight dim when it starts?

hook.en: The starter motor draws a huge current, and the battery's own internal resistance eats up part of its voltage. Real sources are not ideal.
hook.kn: ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟರ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಬಹಳ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿಯ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ ವಿಭವಾಂತರದ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಜವಾದ ಆಕರಗಳು ಆದರ್ಶವಲ್ಲ.

objectives.en: Distinguish ideal and practical voltage and current sources
Convert a voltage source into a current source
State and apply the maximum power transfer theorem

narration.en: The starter motor draws a huge current, and the battery's own internal resistance eats up part of its voltage. Real sources are not ideal.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟರ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಬಹಳ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿಯ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ ವಿಭವಾಂತರದ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಜವಾದ ಆಕರಗಳು ಆದರ್ಶವಲ್ಲ.

body.en: An ideal voltage source keeps its terminal voltage constant for any load; its internal resistance is zero. A practical voltage source has a small series internal resistance r, so $V = E - Ir$. An ideal current source gives a constant current for any load; it has infinite internal resistance. A practical current source has a large resistance in parallel.
body.kn: ಆದರ್ಶ ವಿಭವ ಆಕರದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ ಶೂನ್ಯ; ಅದು ಸ್ಥಿರ ವಿಭವಾಂತರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಜವಾದ ಆಕರದಲ್ಲಿ V = E − Ir. ಆದರ್ಶ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ ಅನಂತ; ಅದು ಸ್ಥಿರ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: An ideal voltage source keeps its terminal voltage constant for any load; its internal resistance is zero. A practical voltage source has a small series internal resistance r, so V = E - Ir. An ideal current source gives a constant current for any load; it has infinite internal resistance. A practical current source has a large resistance in parallel.
narration.kn: ಆದರ್ಶ ವಿಭವ ಆಕರದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ ಶೂನ್ಯ; ಅದು ಸ್ಥಿರ ವಿಭವಾಂತರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಜವಾದ ಆಕರದಲ್ಲಿ V = E − Ir. ಆದರ್ಶ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ ಅನಂತ; ಅದು ಸ್ಥಿರ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Maximum power transfer

say.en: A real source is an ideal emf E in series with a small internal resistance r. Connect a load RL to its terminals.
The terminal voltage falls as current is drawn, because of the drop inside the source.
Plot the load power against RL for E = 12 volts and r = 4 ohms. It rises, peaks and falls. The peak is exactly at RL = r.
Then the maximum power is E squared over 4 r, here 9 watts. But half the power is lost inside, so efficiency is only 50 percent.

body.en: A voltage source E with series resistance r is equivalent, at its terminals, to a current source $I = E/r$ with the same r in parallel. Either form gives the same voltage and current in any load.
body.kn: ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ರೋಧ r ಇರುವ ವಿಭವ ಆಕರ E, ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ r ಇರುವ I = E/r ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾನ.

points.en: I = E/r, r moves from series to parallel
E = I·r for the reverse conversion

narration.en: A voltage source E with series resistance r is equivalent, at its terminals, to a current source I = E/r with the same r in parallel. Either form gives the same voltage and current in any load.
narration.kn: ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ರೋಧ r ಇರುವ ವಿಭವ ಆಕರ E, ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ r ಇರುವ I = E/r ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾನ.

body.en: A source of internal (or Thevenin) resistance $R_s$ delivers maximum power to a load when $R_L = R_s$. Then $P_{max} = E^2/4R_s$ and the efficiency is only 50 %, because half the power is lost inside the source. This matching is used in amplifiers, speakers and antennas.
body.kn: ಭಾರ ರೋಧ RL ಆಕರದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ Rs ಗೆ ಸಮವಾದಾಗ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಗ Pmax = E²/4Rs ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷತೆ 50 %.

narration.en: A source of internal (or Thevenin) resistance Rs delivers maximum power to a load when RL = Rs. Then Pmax = E²/4Rs and the efficiency is only 50 %, because half the power is lost inside the source. This matching is used in amplifiers, speakers and antennas.
narration.kn: ಭಾರ ರೋಧ RL ಆಕರದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ Rs ಗೆ ಸಮವಾದಾಗ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಗ Pmax = E²/4Rs ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷತೆ 50 %.

caption.en: Set E and r of the source, then slide the load. The curve is the load power; the peak sits at RL = r.

tryThis.en: Slide RL to equal r: the power reaches the maximum and the efficiency reads 50%.
Make RL much larger than r: efficiency rises but power falls.

narration.en: Set E and r of the source, then slide the load. The curve is the load power; the peak sits at RL = r. Slide RL to equal r: the power reaches the maximum and the efficiency reads 50%. Make RL much larger than r: efficiency rises but power falls.

problem.en: A 20 V source has internal resistance 4 Ω. Find the load for maximum power and the maximum power.

steps.en: For maximum power, R_L = R_s = 4 Ω.

points.en: An ideal voltage source has zero internal resistance; an ideal current source has infinite internal resistance.
points.kn: ಆದರ್ಶ ವಿಭವ ಆಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದರ್ಶ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಅನಂತ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ.

points.en: E in series with r equals E/r in parallel with r.
points.kn: ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ r ಇರುವ E = ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ r ಇರುವ E/r.

points.en: Maximum power when R_L = R_s; P_max = E²/4R_s at 50 % efficiency.
points.kn: RL = Rs ಆದಾಗ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ; Pmax = E²/4Rs, ದಕ್ಷತೆ 50 %.

homework.en: Convert a 3 A current source with 5 Ω in parallel into a voltage source.

narration.en: Recap. An ideal voltage source has zero internal resistance; an ideal current source has infinite internal resistance. E in series with r equals E/r in parallel with r. Maximum power when R_L = R_s; P_max = E²/4R_s at 50 % efficiency.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆದರ್ಶ ವಿಭವ ಆಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದರ್ಶ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಅನಂತ ಆಂತರಿಕ ರೋಧ. ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ r ಇರುವ E = ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ r ಇರುವ E/r. RL = Rs ಆದಾಗ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ; Pmax = E²/4Rs, ದಕ್ಷತೆ 50 %.
